voiceSummary: Marsons Limited disclosed under Regulation 30 of SEBI regulations that the Board of Directors declared a first interim dividend of five paise per equity share, representing five percent on the face value of one rupee per share for the financial year 2026-27. The record date for determining eligible members is set for 20th November 2026. The company informed shareholders that tax will be deducted at source from the dividend in accordance with the Income Tax Act 2025. Shareholders are required to update their KYC details, including PAN and bank information, with the registrar Maheshwari Datamatics Pvt. Ltd. or their depository participants. Documents for claiming tax exemptions or lower withholding rates must be submitted via the specified online link on or before 20th November 2026.

voiceSummary: Marsons Limited held a Board Meeting on 13th November 2026 to approve the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The results were published in Business Standard and Arthik Lipi on 14th November 2026. The company also submitted an offer estimate to WBSETCL for repairing a 630 kVA station service transformer. The total quoted price for the repair work is 1,37,500 rupees. This amount covers unloading, inspection, active part checking, coil resetting, and tank overhauling. The inspection was conducted on 11th April 2023. The offer was submitted on 16th November 2026.
